LanguageData.WR_FirstStartText: Snow textures for all plants, furniture and items and the flames of hearths, stoves and burning trees and buildings are created once and stored. Afterwards they appear in game right away.
LanguageData.WR_FirstStartLater: You can cancel at any time. Missing textures are created at the next game start or in the mod settings under General. Finished textures are kept.
LanguageData.WR_FirstStartDone: Done. All textures are in the cache.
